C0293.title: Shanxi Cyber Police Strike Back at Online Criminal Activities
C0293.summary: According to an April 13, 2026 Shanxi News report, at 3 a.m. Datong resident Mr. Wang received hundreds of SMS verification codes and his phone nearly became unusable. The report said Shanxi cyber police announced five typical cases in the “Clean Net 2025” campaign, including a Taiyuan case involving an SMS bombing software group that had sold related software more than 2,000 times.
